title: ruilopezia bracteosa
intro: Ruilopezia bracteosa, commonly known as Velvet Flower, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that can help soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ruilopezia bracteosa include its use as an antiseptic, astringent, and expectorant, making it effective in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
